messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/embeddings (prod-us-west). 5xx spike, worker queue depth >95%, incoming QPS ~3x baseline. Impacting marketplace-search & insights-pro. Alert fired at 2026-03-17T10:02:34Z.
mina: I'm taking this — paging @sam.
sam: Ack. Looking at logs/metrics now. Embedding workers OOMing intermittently; rerank sidecars high CPU.
olivia: Can we shift any capacity from chat? Chat lanes look healthy.
sam: Short term plan: 1) Apply per-endpoint quota taper on /v1/embeddings for non-paid tiers. 2) Route heavy keys to low-priority pool. 3) Disable cross-model rerank for free tier. Will post commands.
diane: Noted — I'll open an incident doc and ping CS for customer comms (marketplace-search).
sam: PATCH to quota API to enact soft cap change:
```
PATCH /internal/quotas
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "scope": "global",
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "adjustment": {
    "tier": "free",
    "qps_multiplier": 0.5
  },
  "reason": "live mitigation - embed surge 3921007654"
}
```
sam: Also routing tweak — rerank traffic for keys with tag `heavy-embeds` -> low-priority-pool:
```
POST /internal/routing/actions
{ "action": "carve_route", "route": "/v1/rerank", "selector": "tag:heavy-embeds", "target_pool": "low-priority" }
```
product-ops-bot: Rolling apply started (job id q-98321). Expected propagation ~120s.
sam: Applied soft cap: free-tier embeddings QPS 1200 -> 600 (soft). Added per-key burst limiter for marketplace-search key mkp-zzx to 300r/m.
mina: Metrics update — embedding 5xx rate dropping 14% -> 4% over last 3m, queue depth falling. Good sign.
olivia: I'll flip the feature flag to disable rerank for free tier: `ff:disable-rerank-free = true`.
sam: Done. Flag toggled via admin: `/admin/flags?ff=disable-rerank-free&val=true`
diane: CS: marketplace-search reports degraded relevance but overall functionality retained. Sending customer-safe template now.
mina: I'll monitor for another 10m, then handoff. Leaving notes in incident doc.
diane: Taking over oncall from here @mina — include list of mitigations in the incident ticket and timestamps.
IncidentBot: Severity changed to SEV-2. Continued monitoring required. :white_check_mark:
mina: Thanks all — tagging @pagerduty for any follow-ups. I'll be reachable for 15m.
product-ops-bot: Quota job q-98321 completed; convergence at 00:02:15.
diane: Closing the live mitigation phase — preparing post-incident actions: 1) capacity rebalancing for embed cluster 2) review per-key burst heuristics 3) revisit rerank memory footprint.
IncidentBot: Thread archived to incident-3921007654 in ops-docs.
